film.title: One day at Fernway
film.lede: A short film about a shop, a torn box and a $1,444 refund. Kokoro, one of the voice models the app runs, read the narration on one PC.

record.title: The record of that day
record.lede: Twenty customers wrote in and one sent a photo. The customers were scripted, and the replies, actions and timings are real.

outcome.after: The median first reply was 0.5 seconds, 91% of answers cited a source, and none of it went to a cloud. Your shop will get different numbers.
